title: research(exocon): referential-correctness 축 OPENED — H_9125 contradiction-keyed 🟢 DIRECTIONAL(ON held-out 1.0 vs baseline 0.6765·FLAT 원벽·DECOR earned), F5 벽 grounded영역 열림
body: referential-correctness 축 OPENED — H_9125 CONTRADICTION-KEYED SELECTION engine-native($0 로컬 f5_loop3_contra.hexa, py 없음 grep-clean, live core/engine_cli 위). F5 벽(reference feature-inaccessibility) 정면 대응: vadapt 선택 feature에 contradiction 차원(affect_substrate_features vs grounded referent store) 추가→true-full은 own cell(contra0→dim high)·wrong-def는 other cell(contra1→dim low) 분리. MAIN 4-arm held-out efficacy ON=1.0000(완벽 true 선택) vs OFF/FLAT/DECOR=0.6765(baseline), absolute gap +0.3235≫0.10. 통제 결정적: FLAT(contra off=원벽 재현)=0.6765 미상승·DECOR(store shuffled=earned)=0.6765 붕괴·cells 4>1·Ψ ON==OFF byte-identical(a_substrate_disjoint). metric-caveat(verdict-integrity·c9): pre-reg ΔEff-slope bar가 즉시-step 수렴에 degenerate(0.027, H_9111 Pearson-D 계열)→faithful absolute-gap 결정 통과. grounded 한정(held-out novel=(ii)순환 경계). derivation-trace(H_9124 composition)와 다른 2-피연산자 내부대조.
